reason.detail: Official MCP config sets Vineflower JVM arguments to -Xmx4G; Mavenizer invoked it with -Xms4G inside the mandatory 4 GiB container. Task discovery and clean build both failed during decompilation with MCP step exit 137. No production JAR, server, client, GameTest, or visual qualification completed. Cold resolution also used unapproved plugin-portal and Foojay endpoints, so no compliant network qualification is claimed.
